Self-hosted alternative to Telegram - VOIP + instant messaging
Hello fellow hosters and home-labbers,

I've been using Telegram lately as one of my primary methods of communicating with friends and I'm finally getting fed up with poor performance - primarily dropped calls, not to mentions concerns about privacy. Looking to host something that has both VOIP and instant messaging functionality.

Looking for a modern solution with a back end that I can host and then ideally an app that's already available on app stores that I can easily distribute to my friends. Does a solution like this exist or am I daydreaming?
